changeSet.author: MDonato
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[Execution]') AND name = 'Method') BEGIN alter table api.execution add Method varchar(7); END
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[Execution]') AND name = 'Route') BEGIN alter table api.execution add [Route] varchar(250); END
changeSet.rollback:
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[Execution]') AND name = 'Method') BEGIN alter table api.execution drop column Method; END
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[Execution]') AND name = 'Route') BEGIN alter table api.execution drop column [Route]; END
